title: Social invitation
idea: Social invitation: Inviter identity session scope and decline affordance precede joining
audience: People who need to accept invite within a game surface.
avoidWhen: The invitation exposes private account details
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic conversation layout through its accept invite priority and explicit commitment contract: Joining validates current invitation expiry and permissions
navigation: Social invitation keeps the current accept invite context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Inviter identity session scope and decline affordance precede joining
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to accept invite; players receive real scoped invitations
composition.priority: Joining validates current invitation expiry and permissions

imagery.role: Support the actual accept invite context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep decline reachable and do not steal active gameplay focus
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the social invitation structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no accept invite content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Joining validates current invitation expiry and permissions
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized accept invite content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Joining validates current invitation expiry and permissions
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active accept invite context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
